testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-product-details-after-reorder-from-receipt-and-history.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify product details after reorder from receipt and history

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in, adds a simple product with a checkbox add-on and a second product to the cart, checks the first line, places a COD order with flat-rate shipping, reorders the first product from the receipt and checks it in the cart, empties the cart, then reorders the just-placed order from Order History and checks the first product again. Cart emptied, logout.
steps: Empty storage state: sign in with the declared account, empty the cart
Add product1 (quantity 1) with its checkbox add-on, add product2 (quantity 1, no add-on), open the cart, wait for 2 lines
Check product1's line: name, 'Checkbox : <add-on>' description, SKU, unit cost, quantity, row total
Proceed to checkout, select Ship Complete and the custom flat-rate method (FLAT), select COD, place the order; check the thank-you banner
On the receipt click Reorder for product1's SKU, open the cart, wait for 1 line, check product1's line
Remove all items, check the empty-cart message
Open Order History, click Reorder on the first (most recent) row = the order just placed, open the cart, check product1's line
Empty the cart, log out, check the sign-in link
stateChanges: Places one COD order with flat-rate shipping on the declared account (created by the test, not a need; never deleted)
The signed-in user's cart: emptied, filled, ordered, refilled by two reorders, emptied at the end
Products, add-on, shipping method and COD payment method are only read
assertions: product1 line present with name, 'Checkbox : <addOnDescription>', 'SKU: <sku>', unit cost = price, quantity = quantity, row total close to price x quantity (in the first cart, after the receipt reorder and after the history reorder)
Thank-you banner equals thankYouMessage after placing the order
Empty cart message after removing the receipt-reordered item
Order History has at least one row
evidence: Title: 'verify product details after reorder from receipt and history'
User decision: the order is created by the test (stateChanges); needs are the two products, SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE, PAYMENT_COD_ON_STORE and the declared user

Profile: product1 z-2420004 is an active published SimpleProduct (BlackAndDecker), inventory 235, requiredAddOnCount 0; add-on 580 (z-2661001) is in a CheckBox add-on group, add-on price 3.37, add-on inventory 200 -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK with addOnDisplayType CheckBox

Profile: product2 z-12345886 is an active published BundleProduct (inventory 100) added with no add-on -> PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK with minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0; profile shows storefrontProductIndex 0 (not filtered by store), so the recorded SKU may not meet the key and the resolver falls back
price $32.37 = product price 29.00 + add-on 3.37: expected-output, computed from the resolved product and add-on

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete then lblShippingMethodFLAT -> shippingCode FLAT; the destination is the declared account's default address (masked, not in the test data); countries 'us' is an assumption

The history reorder clicks rows[0] (most recent row), which is the order the test just placed: no existing order is needed. waitForLineItemCount(1) after a reorder of a two-product order is an existing spec quirk, recorded as evidence only

The order is placed on the declared account, so another test that reorders that account's most recent order (verify-product-details-after-reorder-from-existing-order-via-history) must name its resolved order, not rows[0]
product1.id 499 is the PDP product id of product1 (not profiled): role data
Fact from the user: this spec PASSES on atstage unmigrated
